name: Over-the-Counter Cough Syrup
description: Guidelines for traveling with over-the-counter cough syrup in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: OTC cough syrups in carry-on baggage must conform strictly to the 3.4 oz liquids limit. If the bottle is larger than 3.4 oz, it must go in checked baggage, even if partially empty.
conditions: Only prescription liquid medications enjoy the volume exemption.

faq.question: Is over-the-counter cough syrup allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Over-the-Counter Cough Syrup is restricted in carry-on luggage. OTC cough syrups in carry-on baggage must conform strictly to the 3.4 oz liquids limit. If the bottle is larger than 3.4 oz, it must go in checked baggage, even if partially empty.

faq.question: Can you pack over-the-counter cough syrup in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Over-the-Counter Cough Syrup is allowed in checked bags.
